definitions.explanation: The part of a garment covering the arm.

notes:
{袖|そで} means sleeve of clothing.

- ⟦{長袖|ながそで}→長袖：15517_nagasode⟧: long sleeves
- ⟦{半袖|はんそで}→半袖：15518_hansode⟧: short sleeves
- ⟦{袖|そで}なし→袖なし：23859_sodenashi⟧: sleeveless
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{袖|そで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧: long-sleeved kimono
